newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Baloise to sell U.S. unit Providence.
newsitem.headline: Baloise to sell U.S. unit Providence.

text.p: Baloise Holding AG, the holding company for Baloise Insurance Group, said it would sell U.S. subsidiary Providence Washington of Providence, Rhode Island, in the course of 1997.
Baloise Holding said it would first write-off 150 million Swiss francs on the U.S. non-life unit, causing a loss of 81 million Swiss francs at the holding level in the financial year 1996/97.

"The U.S. subsidiary has been in a stable condition for two years. The earnings position is good, but still not satisfactory in relation to the invested capital," baloise said in a statement before a news conference.
